anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: I sanctify myself for these, and not for these only, but also for those who believe.

choices.why: The hyssop-bundle as thoughts rising toward turning.

pass_a_gloss: For if these rushed to obey the legislation according to the thing said, having completed in a bunch of hyssop, that is in an exhalation of thoughts toward turning, which for them the true pascha has been completed, Christ who said: I sanctify myself over these, and not over these only but also over all who believe into you.
pass_b_english: For if these rushed to obey the legislation according to what was said, having completed it in a bunch of hyssop — that is, in an exhalation of thoughts toward turning — which for them the true Passover has been completed, Christ who said: "I sanctify myself for these, and not for these only, but also for all who believe in you." (Exodus 12:22) (John 17:19–20) (Psalm 51:7)
source_text: Εἰ γὰρ τῇ νομοθεσίᾳ κατὰ τὸ εἰρημένον οὗτοι ὥρμησαν <ὑπακούειν> τελέσαντες ἐν δεσμῇ ὑσσώπου, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ἀναθυμιάσει ἐννοιῶν πρὸς ἐπιστρέφειαν, ἣν αὐτοῖς ἐκτετελεσμένον τὸ ἀληθινὸν πάσχα, Χ(ριστὸ)ς ὁ εἰπών· "Ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτὸν ὑπὲρ τούτων, καὶ οὐ τούτων μόνων, ἀλλὰ καὶ ὑπὲρ ὅλων τῶν πιστευόντων εἰς σέ".
